function.description: Screen Pendle term-yield markets across all Pendle-supported chains (some have no active markets) - principal tokens (PT) locking a FIXED rate to a maturity date, yield tokens (YT), and LP. A Pendle market is one underlying asset split into PT and YT with a single EXPIRY: the rate a PT locks is fixed until that date, and nothing about the position floats. Use this when the user asks where to lock a fixed rate, what they would earn if they held to a given date, which maturities exist for an asset, where the highest implied APY is, or how deep a term market is; use `morpho__markets_discover` instead when they want a VARIABLE rate that floats with utilization and has no maturity, and the `solana__lend_*` tools for Solana. Filter by chain, liquidity, implied APY, expiry window, days to maturity, underlying, category, new/prime; sort by liquidity, implied APY, aggregated APY, boosted APY, TVL, volume, expiry or name; every filter that ran is echoed in `filtersApplied` and an off-enum or out-of-range value is rejected by name, never clamped. RETURNS `summary`, `asOf`, `filtersApplied`, `matched`, `returned`, `catalogComplete`, `catalogTotal`, `partial` with `failedChains` and `unsupportedChains`, `chainCounts`, `nextStep`, and `markets`: one row per market carrying `chain`, `market`, `name`, `protocol`, `expiry`, `daysToExpiry`, `matured`, the `pt`, `yt`, `sy` and `underlying` legs each with address, symbol and decimals, `liquidityUsd`, `tvlUsd`, `volume24hUsd`, `impliedApyPercent`, `underlyingApyPercent`, `pendleApyPercent`, `aggregatedApyPercent`, `maxBoostedApyPercent`, `ytFloatingApyPercent`, `swapFeeRateBps`, `categories`, `isNew`, `isPrime`, and `points` and `externalProtocols` risk flags where they apply. APYs are PERCENT values (5 = 5%), liquidity and TVL are USD. Set `fields` to narrow the row shape. PAGE WITH `offset`/`limit`: the reply carries `hasMore` and `nextOffset`, and there is no hidden ceiling, so pass back the `nextOffset` it returned. Set `includeMatured` to also see expired markets, which can only be redeemed or removed, never bought. Read-only.
function.name: pendle__markets_discover

categories.description: Comma-separated Pendle category ids to KEEP (e.g. 'stables,points,ethena').

chainIds.description: Comma-separated chains to scope to (e.g. 'ethereum,arbitrum,base'), or 'all'. Each entry is a chain slug/alias or a numeric chain id. Omit for every Pendle chain. An unsupported chain is rejected by name.

excludeCategories.description: Comma-separated Pendle category ids to EXCLUDE (e.g. 'points' to skip points-farming markets).

expiryAfter.description: Only markets expiring after this ISO-8601 date.

expiryBefore.description: Only markets expiring before this ISO-8601 date (e.g. '2027-01-01').

fields.description: Comma-separated row field groups to keep: identity, apy, liquidity, expiry, legs, points, protocols - or 'all' (default). Use it to keep large result sets small.

includeMatured.description: Include EXPIRED/matured markets (default false). Matured markets can only be redeemed or removed, never bought.

isNew.description: Only markets Pendle flags as new (true), or only established ones (false).

isPrime.description: Only markets Pendle flags as prime (true), or only non-prime (false).

limit.description: Max markets to return (default 20). There is NO hidden ceiling - hasMore and nextOffset report what is left.

maxDaysToExpiry.description: Maximum whole days until maturity - find the nearest maturities.

maxImpliedApyPercent.description: Maximum implied APY as a PERCENT (25 = 25%). Useful to exclude implausible headline rates.

minDaysToExpiry.description: Minimum whole days until maturity. Negative values match already-matured markets.

minImpliedApyPercent.description: Minimum implied APY as a PERCENT (5 = 5%), not a fraction.

minLiquidityUsd.description: Minimum market liquidity in USD - screen out thin markets you could not exit.

offset.description: Row offset for paging (default 0). Pair with the returned nextOffset.

sort.description: Ranking key: liquidity (default), impliedApy, aggregatedApy, underlyingApy, maxBoostedApy, tvl, volume, expiry, name. Anything else is rejected by name.

underlyingSymbol.description: Substring match on the underlying asset symbol or market name (e.g. 'usde', 'weth', 'susd').
